content: Any act of damaging power facilities is illegal and may lead to serious social security problems. I suggest you comply with laws and regulations, protect public facilities, and jointly maintain the safe and stable operation of the power system. If you have other needs or problems, you can further describe your situation and I will do my best to provide legal and compliant advice.
